name: Similarity Search
description: Embed a query with the store's embedding settings and return the top matching retrieval hits.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Maximum number of retrieval hits to return.

parameters.name: score_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum similarity score required for a hit.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional JSON filter with must/should/must_not clause arrays.

parameters.name: include_metadata
parameters.description: Include stored metadata in retrieval hits.
